compute_average_precision: compute the average precision of one search from a list of true positive ranks and total positives
compute_macro_map: compute the macro mean average precision, recall, and precision from ground truth and distance matrices
split_filenames_by_directory: split a list of image filenames into groups based on their parent directory names
evaluate_copydays_results: evaluate copy detection results by computing mAP per block and macro AP across all blocks
compute_cluster_precision_recall: compute precision and recall for each query in a cluster given result IDs and cluster image numbers
